element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

paths.description: Absolute paths to files to drop onto the element.

data.description: Data to drop, expressed as an array of entries because dynamic-key maps are not supported in strict mode. Each entry contains a MIME type in key and its payload string in value. Example: [{"key": "text/plain", "value": "hello"}, {"key": "text/uri-list", "value": "https://example.com"}].

key.description: MIME type key, for example text/plain or text/uri-list

value.description: Payload string associated with the MIME type key, for example hello or https://example.com
